# @javaabu/forms

> The React version of the javaabu/forms Laravel Blade components: the same components and attributes, model binding, old input, Laravel validation errors, Inertia and Wayfinder support, English and Dhivehi strings, and RTL. Components render through a UI adapter: Onu, shadcn/ui, plain HTML, or your own.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's node_modules/@javaabu/forms/.

## Rules

- Import components from `@javaabu/forms`. Set the UI adapter once, at the root: `<FormsProvider ui={onu}>` (`onu` from `@javaabu/forms/onu`), `createShadcnAdapter({...})` from `@javaabu/forms/shadcn`, or nothing for plain HTML.
- Use the Blade component names and attributes: `<x-forms::select2 name="country" relation />` is `<Select2 name="country" relation />`. Attributes are camelCase props, named slots are props (`help`, `prepend`), the default slot is `children`.
- Let names do the work. Don't pass `id` or `label` unless they differ from what the name gives (`address[city]` → id `address-city`, label "Address City", translated with `__()`).
- Bind data with `<Form model={user}>` (or `<Model>`), not `value`. Values come from old input, then the model, then `default`. Pass `value` only for a controlled field, with its change handler.
- Use bracket names for nested and array fields, as in Blade: `address[city]`, `items[0][name]`, `channels[]` for checkbox groups, `tags[]` (or `multiple`) for multi-selects.
- Don't render validation errors yourself. Fields show their own errors, from Inertia page props, `useForm()`, a 422 response, `Form errors` or `FormsProvider errors`. Use `errorBag` for named bags and `<Errors name>` or `<ErrorSummary>` only for extra placements.
- With Inertia, set `router={inertia}` (from `@javaabu/forms/inertia`) on the root `FormsProvider`, then use plain forms: `<Form model={user} action={update}>`. Or pass `useForm()` to `<Form form={form}>`. Don't wire `onSubmit`, `errors` or `processing` by hand for Inertia.
- Use Wayfinder routes as `action`: `action={store()}`, or the route function itself, `action={update}`, which is called with the form's `model`. The method comes from the route; `PUT`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` are spoofed with `_method`.
- File inputs need `<Form files>`. Don't nest forms.
- Add `thaana` to free-text fields that take Dhivehi. Never hard-code user-facing English: use `__()` from `@javaabu/i18n` for your labels. Package strings are `forms::strings.*`, changed in `lang/vendor/forms/{locale}/strings.php`.
- Use logical CSS (`ms-`, `pe-`, `start-`, `text-start`), never `left`/`right`, so pages work in RTL.
- To change how one component looks, replace its slot (`<FormsProvider components={{ Select: MySelect }}>`) instead of wrapping or forking the component. To support a new UI kit, write an adapter and run `testAdapter()` from `@javaabu/forms/testing`.
